levels.surface: عامر بن سعد بن أبي وقاص

notes: «- وهو ابن إسماعيل -» is an editor gloss and is left out
«كتبت إلى جابر بن سمرة» is a letter: the writer and the one written to who answers form the route (rule 5); the messenger «نافع» is not a link
The several sayings («وسمعته يقول ...») all come from this one letter, so one group with no saying label
